en: *The New Sutra on Bodhisattvas*, one fascicle.
Imperial decree issued by Jia Dan to the sentient beings of all provinces: Every day, recite the name of Amitābha Buddha one thousand times;
sever evil and practice good. This year there has been great heat, and no one has harvested the crops. There are several types [of grain].
Death by disease;
first, death by pestilence;
second, death by the movements of heavenly bodies.
The third dies from exhaustion;
the fourth dies from dropsy;
the fifth dies during childbirth.
The sixth is death from abdominal ailments;
the seventh is death from blood abscesses;
the eighth is death from wind-bile disease.
The ninth dies in water;
the tenth dies from eye disease.
I exhort all sentient beings to copy one copy [of this text] so as to spare themselves from such a fate.
Transcribe two copies and one family shall be spared;
transcribe three copies and one village shall be spared.
If you do not transcribe them, your entire lineage shall be exterminated.
By passing by the side of the gate, one may overcome this difficulty.
Simply observe that during the seventh and eighth months, three households employ one ox and five men share a single wife, while monks and nuns go from door to door,
urging people to copy this sutra.
On the second day of the first month in the Western Liang state, at the height of midday,
there was the sound of thunder and rain;
a stone as large as a peck measure fell down.
The stone then split into two pieces, and this sutra was revealed within.
It was reported to all sentient beings: "Now you bear many afflictions.
*Xin pusa jing* (New Bodhisattva Sutra), one fascicle.
